cosine.rule: cosine of the topics’ word probabilities over both models’ words (0 where a word is not one model’s); a topic recurs at the threshold or above
cosine.calibration: the lower quartile of the cosines of topics that are each other’s best match across two seeds of one setting (74 pairs; median 0.777, least 0.458)

note: Eight topics of the manuscript before revision (stage 0), in 65 chunks of about 400 words, without MEL’s composition notes. Made with the reading-text model’s settings (K 8, min 2) so that the two differ only in their text. Topics 2, 6 and 8 recur in all four other seeds of the check, 1, 3 and 7 in three, 5 in two; topic 4 (back, took, aloft, pipe) in none, so read it as noise. Against the reading text, by cosine: topics 2 (Vere, the court), 8 (Billy), 5 (Claggart) and 6 (the deck, the watch) match, and 1 (war, mutiny, 0.698) and 3 (the human heart, the purser, 0.669) fall just below the threshold of 0.703. The count depends on the settings: with min 3, two topics match. The list of stages is still to be settled.

compare.rule: cosine of the topics’ word probabilities, (count + beta) / (tokens + V·beta) over each model’s own words, compared over the union of the two models’ words (2313), 0 where a word is not one model’s
compare.thresholdFrom: this model’s seed check (the lower quartile of the cosines of topics that are each other’s best match across two seeds of one setting (74 pairs; median 0.777, least 0.458))
